'''Zhu Qihe''' ({{zh|s=朱起鹤}}; 12 July 1924 – 20 February 2024) was a Chinese physical chemist, and an academician of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]]. He was a member of the [[Chinese Communist Party]] (CCP).<ref>{{cite news |url=https://news.sciencenet.cn/htmlnews/2024/2/517859.shtm |script-title=zh:中国科学院院士、我国著名物理化学家朱起鹤逝世 |work=sciencenet.cn |date=23 February 2024 |access-date=24 February 2024 |language=zh}}</ref>

==Biography==
Zhu was born in [[Beijing]], on 12 July 1924, to {{ill|Zhu Jisheng|zh|朱继圣}} (1894–1972), an industrialist.<ref name="Zhu">{{cite news |url=https://new.qq.com/rain/a/20240221A06GLK00 |script-title=zh:朱起鹤院士逝世 |work=qq.com |date=21 January 2024 |access-date=24 February 2024 |language=zh}}</ref> He attended [[Tianjin]] [[Yaohua High School]].<ref>{{cite news |author1=Ma Yuan ({{lang|zh|马媛}}) |url=https://www.thepaper.cn/newsDetail_forward_26416070 |script-title=zh:中科院院士朱起鹤逝世！曾于耀华读书！享年100岁！ |work=thepaper |date=21 February 2024 |access-date=24 February 2024 |language=zh}}</ref> He graduated from the Department of Chemical Engineering, [[National Central University]] in 1947 before gaining a doctor's degree from the [[University of California, Berkeley]] under direction of [[William Giauque|William Francis Giauque]].<ref name="Zhu"/>

Zhu returned to China in 1951 and that same year joined the faculty of the Department of Chemistry at [[Yenching University]] and then [[Peking University]].<ref name="Zhu"/> He was transferred to [[National University of Defense Technology|Harbin Institute of Military Engineering]] (now National University of Defense Technology) in 1952, where he worked for 26 years.<ref name="Zhu"/> In 1978, he moved to the [[Institute of High Energy Physics]], responsible for research projects such as superconducting magnets, superconducting microwave cavities, and laser acceleration.<ref name="Zhu"/> In 1981, he became professor in the Institute of Chemistry of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]], where he mainly focused on the establishment of the molecular reaction dynamics laboratory.<ref name="Zhu"/>

His primary research focus was on molecular reaction dynamics. He successfully developed six large-scale experiments utilizing molecular beams and lasers, enabling diverse scientific research endeavors. In the realm of molecular photolysis, he clarified the photodissociation mechanisms of molecules such as alkyl iodides, halogenated olefins, and ketones, proposing microscopic reaction mechanisms. In cluster studies, he made groundbreaking discoveries of a new class of hydrogen-containing carbon clusters, positing their tubular structures. Additionally, he identified a series of binary clusters comprising metals and sulfur, elucidating their composition patterns, stability, photodissociation behaviors, and the kinetics of cluster formation.<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Cheng |first1=Min |last2=Yu |first2=Zijun |last3=Hu |first3=Lili |last4=Yu |first4=Dan |last5=Dong |first5=Changwu |last6=Du |first6=Yikui |last7=Zhu |first7=Qihe |date=2011-02-24 |title=Vibrationally Resolved Photofragment Translational Spectroscopy of CH 3 I from 277 to 304 nm with Increasing Effect of the Hot Band |url=https://pubs.acs.org/doi/10.1021/jp106624q |journal=The Journal of Physical Chemistry A |language=en |volume=115 |issue=7 |pages=1153–1160 |doi=10.1021/jp106624q |pmid=21271744 |bibcode=2011JPCA..115.1153C |issn=1089-5639|url-access=subscription }}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Liu |first1=Peng |last2=Han |first2=Chunying |last3=Gao |first3=Zhen |last4=Kong |first4=Fanao |last5=Zhu |first5=Qihe |date=1999-04-01 |title=Study of Reactions of Silver and Sulfur Clusters |url=https://pubs.acs.org/doi/10.1021/jp984560k |journal=The Journal of Physical Chemistry B |language=en |volume=103 |issue=17 |pages=3337–3339 |doi=10.1021/jp984560k |issn=1520-6106|url-access=subscription }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=朱起鹤--中国科学院化学研究所 |url=http://www.ic.cas.cn/team/ys/202307/t20230725_6828723.html |access-date=2024-02-26 |website=www.ic.cas.cn}}</ref>

On 20 February 2024, he died of an illness in Beijing, at the age of 99.<ref name="Zhu"/>

==Honours and awards==
* 1995 Member of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] (CAS)<ref name="Zhu"/>
